name: analyze_gas_composition
description: Read gas grades from База технологических газов. Use base=Ar, H, He, or the exact class name. For shared impurities pass compare_with for the second class. Returns the intersection of components with an upper limit found in at least one grade of each class, with evidence from both classes. Otherwise ranks grades by the lower bound of their main gas volume percentage and returns full recognized compositions. Keeps ≥ and ≤, never treats bounds as exact. Only the monogas classes are compared.

name: compare_node_children
description: Compute common direct-child labels of two distinct lists selected from search_inforesource. For impurities, first find the actual impurity lists under each gas record, never compare the chemical elements themselves. Supply pointers and hash from the SAME export and depth. Changed exports, empty/unresolved lists fail explicitly. Output contains evidence for both sides of every match. This compares labels, not chemical synonyms; results cover only the returned lists.

name: count_graph
description: Count occurrences, defined IDs and links in a bounded export, including ancestors. Never a full graph count. Link targets are not resolved; depth=0 normally yields one root and zero edges.

name: create_folder
description: Create a folder in the user's IACPaaS fund, live only. parent='' means fund root; name is one component. Requires an explicit user request. Does not create an inforesource or edit catalog.json. Never automatically retry after a connection error.

name: delete_folder
description: Move a folder from My Fund to the IACPaaS recycle bin. Live HTTP server with --login --fund-login required. Call only after the user explicitly requests deletion and gives the exact folder path. confirm_path must equal path. Never retry automatically.

name: get_inforesource
description: Read metadata and root (depth=0). Use exact path returned by list_inforesources or list_fund_resources. IDs are strings.

name: get_subgraph
description: Read a bounded universal export, depth 0..3. Empty start means resource root; otherwise use a known IACPaaS concept path. Ancestors may be included. Snapshot mode has only depth=0.

name: list_fund_resources
description: Search resource titles/paths in the authenticated My Fund, including subfolders, up to 16 folders per call. Empty parent starts at the fund root. Check truncated/skipped_folders. Returned paths can be read or searched immediately.

name: list_inforesources
description: Search configured resources by title/path. This is a local catalog, not a live listing of the user's fund; access is checked only when reading.

name: rank_records_by_percentage
description: Rank live IACPaaS records under one group by an exact percentage. Use the group's pointer and same export hash/depth from search. Supply exact relative node labels from each record to its composition, then from composition to the component's percentage value. Verify one common percentage basis and units in the graph before calling. Returns rows and evidence for records, composition and percentages. Reports skipped rows.

name: search_fund_content
description: Search node contents in up to 12 resources in authenticated My Fund. Supply separate terms, e.g. водород, аргон, примес, состав. Searches inside exports even when no resource title matches. Each report shows counts, sample hits, pointers and export hash. Check truncated, skipped_folders and resource errors; use search_inforesource for more hits in a specific resource.

name: search_inforesource
description: Search inside a resource found in the catalog or My Fund. Query is a literal case-insensitive substring in name/value/meta/link/comment; try one term, formula or stem at a time. Returns fields, trails, pointers and evidence IDs. Depth 0..10; an empty result only applies to this export and term.
